title: iranecio davisii
intro: Iranecio davisii, commonly known as the Davis' yarrow, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. Iranecio davisii has been traditionally used to treat inflammatory conditions, wounds, and skin irritations due to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contribute to its health benefits, which may include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and promoting wound healing.
